form.label: Claude Enterprise - User Drilldown
form.description: Who is using what, and how: per-user spend, tokens, product mix, and behavior. Note: Anthropic attributes model usage at the organization level only - model mix is shown org-wide, not per user.

search.query: `claude_index` (sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_usage" OR sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_cost" OR sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_activity") | stats count by email | sort email

panel.title: Team Utilization Profile (click a row to drill into that user)

search.query: `claude_index` (sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_cost" OR sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_usage" OR sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_activity" OR sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity") (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$" OR actor_email="$user$" OR entity_email="$user$" OR target_email="$user$") | eval email=coalesce(email, actor_email, entity_email, target_email) | where isnotnull(email) AND email!="" AND email!="null" | eval cost_usd=if(sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_cost", coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, total_cost_usd), null()) | eval tok=if(sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_usage", coalesce(output_tokens,0)+coalesce(uncached_input_tokens,0)+coalesce(cache_read_input_tokens,0), null()) | eval product_dim=if(like(sourcetype,"anthropic:analytics:user_%"), product, null()) | eval product_dim=case(product_dim="claude_code","Claude Code", product_dim="cowork","Cowork", product_dim="office_agent","Office Agent", product_dim="chat","Claude.ai", isnotnull(product_dim), product_dim) | eval chat_ev=if(sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" AND (like(event_type,"claude_chat%") OR like(event_type,"conversation%")), 1, null()) | eval file_ev=if(sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" AND like(event_type,"claude_file%"), 1, null()) | eval artifact_ev=if(sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" AND like(event_type,"claude_artifact%"), 1, null()) | stats sum(cost_usd) AS spend_usd sum(tok) AS tokens values(product_dim) AS products sum('claude_code_metrics.tool_accepted_count') AS cc_tools sum('chat_metrics.connectors_used_count') AS chat_connectors sum('cowork_metrics.connectors_used_count') AS cowork_connectors sum(chat_ev) AS chats sum(file_ev) AS files sum(artifact_ev) AS artifacts max(_time) AS last_active by email | eval spend_usd=round(coalesce(spend_usd,0),2), tokens=coalesce(tokens,0) | eval connectors=coalesce(chat_connectors,0)+coalesce(cowork_connectors,0) | eval behavior=case(coalesce(cc_tools,0)>0 AND coalesce(chats,0)>0, "Developer + Chat", coalesce(cc_tools,0)>0, "Developer (Claude Code)", coalesce(artifacts,0)>0, "Builder (artifacts)", coalesce(files,0)>0, "Analyst (file-heavy)", coalesce(chats,0)>0, "Chat user", tokens>0 OR spend_usd>0, "API/background usage", true(), "Inactive") | eval last_active=strftime(last_active, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | sort - spend_usd | table email, spend_usd, tokens, products, behavior, chats, files, artifacts, cc_tools, connectors, last_active | rename email AS user, spend_usd AS "spend (USD)", products AS "products used", cc_tools AS "Claude Code tools accepted", chats AS "chat events", files AS "file events", artifacts AS "artifact events", last_active AS "last active"

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_cost" (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | eval cost_usd=coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, total_cost_usd) | eval product_label=case(product="claude_code","Claude Code", product="cowork","Cowork", product="office_agent","Office Agent", product="chat","Claude.ai", isnotnull(product), product, 1=1, "Unattributed") | chart sum(cost_usd) AS spend over email by product_label | sort - spend

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_usage" (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | eval tokens=coalesce(output_tokens,0)+coalesce(uncached_input_tokens,0)+coalesce(cache_read_input_tokens,0) | eval product_label=case(product="claude_code","Claude Code", product="cowork","Cowork", product="office_agent","Office Agent", product="chat","Claude.ai", isnotnull(product), product, 1=1, "Unattributed") | chart sum(tokens) AS tokens over email by product_label | sort - tokens

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_cost" (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | eval cost_usd=coalesce(tonumber(amount)/100, total_cost_usd) | timechart span=1d sum(cost_usd) AS spend by email limit=10 useother=true

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_usage" (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | eval tokens=coalesce(output_tokens,0)+coalesce(uncached_input_tokens,0)+coalesce(cache_read_input_tokens,0) | eval product_label=case(product="claude_code","Claude Code", product="cowork","Cowork", product="office_agent","Office Agent", product="chat","Claude.ai", isnotnull(product), product, 1=1, "Unattributed") | stats sum(tokens) AS tokens by product_label

panel.title: Org-wide Model Mix (context; not attributable per user)

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:usage" model=* | eval tokens=coalesce(output_tokens,0)+coalesce(uncached_input_tokens,0)+coalesce(cache_read_input_tokens,0) | stats sum(tokens) AS tokens by model | sort - tokens

panel.title: Selected User: Engagement Metrics Over Time

search.query: `claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:analytics:user_activity" (("$user$"="*") OR email="$user$") | timechart span=1d sum('claude_code_metrics.tool_accepted_count') AS "Claude Code tools accepted" sum('chat_metrics.connectors_used_count') AS "Chat connectors used" sum('cowork_metrics.connectors_used_count') AS "Cowork connectors used"

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" NOT event_type=compliance_api_accessed (("$user$"="*") OR actor_email="$user$" OR entity_email="$user$" OR target_email="$user$") | where isnotnull(event_type) AND event_type!="" | timechart span=1d limit=10 useother=true count by event_type

`claude_index` sourcetype="anthropic:compliance:activity" NOT event_type=compliance_api_accessed (("$user$"="*") OR actor_email="$user$" OR entity_email="$user$" OR target_email="$user$") | `claude_actor_email` | where isnotnull(actor_email) AND actor_email!="null" | table _time, actor_email, event_type, claude_project_id, claude_chat_id, actor_ip_address | sort - _time | head 50
